sidebar.subtitle: AI Agent Skills manager
overview.title: Overview
tools.title: Tools
tools.subtitle: Disabled tools are excluded from scanning and deployment. The folder button opens the directory in your file manager.
tools.emptyDesc: Install a tool such as Claude Code, then restart the app to detect it automatically.
tools.undetectedHint: This tool's config directory does not exist yet — launch the tool once to make it detectable
library.emptyDesc: Run a scan to register the skills already present in your AI tool directories.
library.noMatchDesc: Try different keywords or a different source filter.
library.noTagsDesc: Tag editing will arrive in a later version; use the source filter for now.
library.scanDoneBody: Found {total} skill directories, {known} of them already registered.
library.scanDoneUnregistered: The following directories are not registered yet (registering moves no files):
library.revokeOne: This removes the deployment of "{skill}" in {tool} (links / copies are moved to trash).
library.revokeAll: This removes the deployment of "{skill}" in {n} tools (links / copies are moved to trash).
library.revokeNote: The master copy stays in the central library and can be redeployed anytime.
library.deleteBodyTrash: the master copy moves to trash and can be restored from the Toolbox in a later version.
detail.editHintNormal: Errors block saving; warnings do not
detail.validationOk: Validation passed: frontmatter is complete, no other issues found.
detail.saveOk: Saved (previous version backed up as SKILL.md.bak)
detail.updateArchiveNoSupport: Skills imported from archives cannot be updated online; delete and re-import the new archive instead.
detail.updateUnsupportedDefault: This source does not support updates.
detail.updateAppliedToast: Updated to {rev} (old version moved to trash)
detail.deployReadOnlyDesc: Comes from a plugin cache (extra_scan_dirs); deployment is not allowed.
detail.deployNone: Not deployed to any tool yet.
detail.applyConfirmBody: The master copy of "{skill}" will be replaced with the new content; the old version moves to trash and is never erased directly.
detail.applyConfirmDiffNote: The diff summary is shown above.
detail.discardBody: The editor has unsaved changes. Once discarded they cannot be recovered (the automatic backup is only written on save).
security.noFindings: No findings (purely static scan, for reference only).
doctor.kind.unmanagedRealDir: A folder in this directory is not managed by SkillBox — it may be yours
doctor.kind.brokenLink: A deployed link points to a location that no longer exists (dangling link)
doctor.kind.foreignLink: A link points outside the SkillBox central library; SkillBox will not touch it
doctor.kind.missingTarget: Recorded as deployed, but missing on disk
doctor.kind.unrecordedDeployment: A SkillBox-style link exists on disk but SkillBox has no record of it
doctor.kind.copyDrift: A copy differs from the master copy in the central library (may have been edited manually)
doctor.kind.duplicateName: Same-named but different skills exist in multiple directories
doctor.title: Doctor
doctor.allClearDesc: The central library and all tool deployments are consistent; nothing needs attention.
doctor.impactPaths: The following paths will be affected:
doctor.viewDiffHint: You must decide which same-named copy is authoritative: SkillBox never picks a master automatically nor touches these directories. After deciding which version to keep, delete or rename the others manually.
toolbox.title: Toolbox
toolbox.subtitle: Pro features folded away: security scanning and context cost analysis.
toolbox.securityFindingsSummary: {n} findings in total. Per-skill details are listed below.
toolbox.securityEmpty: No aggregated findings yet. Click "Scan all" for a purely static scan of the library.
toolbox.conflictHint: When two descriptions are highly similar, their trigger words compete; deactivating one reduces mis-triggering.
toolbox.moreDesc: Log export, cache and trash management will join the toolbox in a later version.
firstrun.welcomeP1: SkillBox registers and manages the skills scattered across your AI tool directories. It starts by scanning directories of tools like Claude Code and Codex for existing skills.
firstrun.welcomeP2: The first run only scans and registers. It never moves, modifies, or deletes any of your files.
firstrun.summaryNone: No existing skills found. You can register them later from the Library page.
firstrun.unifyOn: Each selected skill will be copied into the central library and its original directory replaced with a link to the master copy; originals are moved to trash first (recoverable).
firstrun.unifyOff: By default skills are registered in place: only the location is recorded, no file is moved or modified. You can deploy them to each tool from their cards later.
firstrun.doneInPlaceNote: . Registered in place; file locations unchanged.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: App preferences, applied immediately and saved automatically.
settings.languageHint: Switch the interface language; takes effect immediately.
settings.centralDesc: The single home for master copies: ~/.skillbox/skills (§3.1 layout).
